items.text: The delivery was prompt, and the food was hot upon arrival. Very pleased with the service.
The salad I received was entirely missing the dressing and several vegetables. I am concerned about the quality control.
Can you advise on the process for getting a refund for the missing items on my order?
The driver was friendly and highly professional during the drop-off, which made the experience much better.
My payment was processed correctly, but the order arrived two hours later than the estimate. This is unacceptable.
I wish there were more options for plant-based milk in the drink category on the app.
The burger was soggy when I opened the bag. It seems like it sat in the delivery bag for too long.
I would like to know if it is possible to change the delivery address for an order that has already been confirmed.
Everything tasted fresh, and the packaging was eco-friendly. I appreciate your commitment to quality.
The order arrived, but the total charged on my bank statement does not match the estimated price on the app.
Is it possible to get tracking updates before the driver is even dispatched from the kitchen?
The portion sizes felt much better this time compared to my last two orders. Good improvement.
The app interface is a little slow when trying to select payment methods during checkout.
My order was correct, but the item temperature was unsatisfactory. It was lukewarm.
How can I provide feedback on the delivery experience specifically, separate from the food quality?
I really enjoyed the variety of options in the dessert section. Excellent selection for late-night viewing.
The driver left the food outside my gate. This was fine, but a more specific instruction would have been helpful.
The crust on the pizza was slightly burned, making the entire meal difficult to eat. Very disappointing.
Is there a specific way to request a larger tip for the driver within the app menu?
This was one of the fastest deliveries I have ever received. Great job by the kitchen team!
A notification about a delayed order showed up, but the estimated arrival time was inaccurate.
I am not sure if the loyalty points are applied correctly to this specific order type. Could you clarify?
The vegetables in my side dish were wilted and had no flavor. They seemed pre-made for a while.
The ambiance of having good food delivered at home is always the best. Thank you for making this possible.
It would be great if the app provided a more granular view of the order preparation timeline.
The delivery instructions specified 'gate code 1234', but the driver seemed unaware of this detail.
Do you ever offer promotions or discounts for first-time customers using a new service provider?
My order was missing the dipping sauce that I specifically requested in the notes section.
The packaging held up very well and kept the contents secure and undamaged during transit.
The website version of the app sometimes lags when trying to search for specific menu items.
I noticed that the estimated delivery time was exceeded by nearly forty minutes without any updates.
My order was fantastic. Everything was hot, fresh, and arrived perfectly timed. Highly recommended.
The driver found my house quickly, even though the address provided was quite complex.
I am curious if there is a feature where I can save my preferred delivery address for future use?
The order was correct, but the delivery instructions I wrote were ignored by the driver.
